summary: Dependency sourced from mutable GitHub HEAD tarball
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` as `https://github.com/WhiskeySockets/libsignal-node/archive/HEAD.tar.gz` — an off-registry tarball URL pointing at the mutable `HEAD` ref of a GitHub repository rather than a registry version range or a pinned commit SHA. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that URL returns at the moment of install and installs the result, with no version pin, no integrity hash, and no signature check. Any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched tarball execute on the installer during install. Whoever controls the upstream repository (or any party able to influence the branch head or the delivery path) can change what code runs on every future installer without any change to this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
